message.content:
<summary>
Task: OCR 22 receipt images in /app/workspace/dataset/img and write filename, ISO date, and total_amount (2-decimal string) to /app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx sheet "results" ordered by filename.

Turns 1–2: Listed 22 files (007..097.jpg).

Turns 3–5: Ran default pytesseract OCR on all 22 images to inspect content. Confirmed varied receipt layouts (POS, McDonald's, IKEA, Shell, etc.) with dates in DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YY variants and totals labeled GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL / TOTAL RM / Total Rounded / Total (Inclusive of GST) / Net Total, etc. Also noted GST summary tables that repeat "Total" with net (excl-GST) figures we must avoid.

Turn 6: Created /app/workspace/extract.py implementing exclusion patterns (SUB TOTAL, DISCOUNT, CHANGE, CASH TENDERED, tax lines), priority tiers (GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM > TOTAL AMOUNT > TOTAL/NET TOTAL/AMOUNT DUE etc.), a decimal number regex, date extraction (DD/MM/YYYY, DD/MM/YY→20YY, YYYY/MM/DD), openpyxl output.

Turn 7: First run produced many Nones/wrong values: 009 (None—Cash Tendered line issue), 011 (None), 074 (None - "Total inel." OCR'd as 702.00 would've been picked but was None), 063 date None, 071 date None, 077 None, 083 None, 087/088 date None, 094 None.

Turn 8: Debugged 074 — default OCR mangled "Total incl. of GST 102.00" as "Total inel. of GBT 702.00".

Turn 9: Confirmed only Tier-3 matched on 074, picked "Total Item(s): 4" (no number) after last-candidate-only logic.

Turn 10: Tried preprocessing (grayscale + autocontrast) with psm 6/4/11. psm 6 with preprocessing significantly improved OCR: recovered dates on 063/077/087/088, and clean totals on 074 (102.00), 077 (23.25), 083 (18.80), 087/088, 094 etc.

Turns 11–14: Updated extract.py to (a) import ImageOps, (b) add exclusions for "Total Items/Qty/Savings" and "Item Count", (c) add SUMMARY_HEADER_RE to cut off the GST/Tax summary block and only scan candidate lines before it, (d) iterate candidates last-to-first with next-line fallback, (e) preprocess with grayscale+autocontrast and use --psm 6.

Turn 15: Re-ran; now all 22 rows have both date and total populated. Sample outputs: 007=2019-01-23/20.00, 009=2018-01-18/26.60, 034=2018-03-09/332.30, 052=2018-03-23/None-for-total (still failing — 052 has GRAND TOTAL 10.00 but current run shows total=None), 074=2018-03-20/702.00 (WRONG — should be 102.00; new preprocessing didn't help this specific field because the summary-cutoff isn't in effect there and Tier-3 last candidate "Total Amt Rounded" line was OCR'd 702.00), 077=2017-10-29/23.25, 078=2017-02-02/100.00 (likely wrong; receipt Grand Total is 92.80; "Cash Received 100.00" may have been picked — needs Change/Cash exclusion review, though "Change" already excluded; "Cash Received" isn't excluded), 097=2018-01-12/21.00.

Remaining concerns to verify in next round:
- 052 total=None despite "GRAND TOTAL 10.00" in original OCR.
- 074 total=702.00 vs likely truth 102.00 (OCR error digit misread).
- 078 total=100.00 vs likely 92.80 (picking "Cash Received"; add exclusion for "CASH RECEIVED" / "CASH" alone? but "Cash 20.00" appears in others where actual total should still come from TOTAL keyword; ordering by "GRAND TOTAL"/tier-1 should win — 078 has "Grand Total 92.80" per turn-5 OCR, so re-check preprocessed OCR).
- 034 total 332.30 vs earlier 348.50 — with new logic 332.30 may be correct (matches receipt "Total (RM): 332.30").
- Date correctness for 034 (2018-03-09 vs receipt shown 09/08/2018 = 2018-08-09) — likely a DD/MM confusion where preprocessed OCR read differently; needs verification.
- File saved at /app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx.

Script is in place and mostly working; next round should validate individual outputs against source OCR and refine (add "CASH RECEIVED"/"CASH" exclusion, prefer higher-tier matches even if lower on page, handle 052 grand-total detection).
</summary>
